'''Goh's Trapinch''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのナックラー''' ''Go's Nuckrar'') is the sixth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], and his sixtieth overall.

==History==
==={{aniseries|JN}}===
[[File:Goh and Trapinch.png|250px|left|thumb|Trapinch and Goh]]
In ''[[JN036|Making Battles in the Sand!]]'', [[Goh]] first encountered {{p|Trapinch}} when he and {{Ash}} were investigating a Sandstorm that had hit [[Mauville City]]. Goh consults his [[Pokédex]], learning that Trapinch digs bowl-shaped pits to trap and hunt prey. Goh decides he will have to catch Trapinch to save the people. A standard throw failed, but he managed to catch the {{pkmn|category|Ant Pit Pokémon}} with a curveball. 

In ''[[JN064|Absol Absolved!]]'', Goh sent Trapinch out and had it use {{m|Dig}} to investigate underground in an oddly snowy portion of [[Mt. Chimney]]. However, it quickly resurfaced, shuddering from the cold, and Goh promptly [[recall]]ed it.

In ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'', Goh used Trapinch, along with other Pokémon in [[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]], to create a pond for {{TP|Goh|Grimer}} to live in without dirtying the park's water stream.

In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Trapinch joined the rest of Goh's Pokémon at the lab to celebrate their Trainer's return from the last mission of [[Project Mew]]. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', it attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.

==Personality and characteristics==
Trapinch seems to be a trustworthy and helpful Pokémon, where it helped [[Goh]] and his other Pokémon create a pond for {{TP|Goh|Grimer}} to live in, and celebrated their success afterwards.
